name: Sourcegraph public code search (stream API)
tier_rationale: Established company with published ToS, AUP, privacy policy and paid plans (A8 BR2; P305 cond 1: all code search sources trusted).
tier_reviewer: batch p2-G14-3 (council-1 P304 cond 5: initial tiers, reviewer confirms)

reliability.justification: Indexes public repositories; the index can lag and the public instance degrades (backend-missing), so an empty answer with warnings is 'could not verify'.

sourcegraph.description: Sourcegraph.com access token (optional: raises the anonymous limits; header only)
sourcegraph.plan_hint: business = a token of a company/team account whose plan permits internal business use (P305 cond 2)

public_stream_search.title: sourcegraph.com/.api/search/stream (text/event-stream; keyless, optional token)

terms.quote: 3.1 ... license to access and use the Services in order to review and analyze Code Data ... solely for your internal business purposes.
terms.reviewer: batch p2-G14-3 (P305 cond 2: ToS evidence recorded, legal_dpo confirms)

public_stream_search.notes: ToS last modified 2026-07-22 (s.3.1 internal business purposes; Self-Serve use subject to reasonable use) and AUP 2026-06-12 ('You may not use Sourcegraph to engage in automatic or excessive bulk activity'): bounded use only (P305 cond 3: <= 3 queries per entity, seed/org-asset scope, 20 s budget). If legal rules business use out, set the class to 'unknown' and the policy gate skips the source (reason_code 'licence'). Streams are read with max_bytes 2 MB and a 30 s deadline; raw bodies are never cached (ttl 0, P305 cond 6). Used by code_search.

notes: Owned by batch p2-G14-3 (P305, module code_search). No published anonymous limit and no rate-limit headers were seen (prep run 2026-11-26): a conservative observed budget of 200 queries a day at 0.5 request/s (80% margin applied by the quota book). The optional token goes only in the Authorization header ('token <t>'), never in a URL or log (AR01).
